Hi Neha,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed. Procurement asked me to consolidate the compliance items we need from Redwood before we can issue a PO and connect billing. Can you please confirm the following and next steps so I can route internally?

- DPA (we typically need an executed copy)
- SOC 2 report (or a link to a hosted read-only report)
- Current subprocessor inventory (CSV or spreadsheet)
- A one-page PO / invoice routing instruction (who to send PO to, billing contact, payment terms)

We will need the DPA countersigned by your legal or a DocuSign link we can sign. Also please let us know if you require our vendor intake form — I can attach it.

Target timeline is end of next week (7/26) if possible.

Thanks,

- Billing contact name and AP email that will receive invoices and POs.
- Desired PO terms (Net30/Net45) and a billing address for PO.
